name: Eskil the White
description: A descendant of Xarl who became his spellsquire, inherited the House of Xarl and became a Planeswalker.

description_citations.text: "Xarl". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xarl elevates Elazar to duke in exchange for taking Eskil as apprentice.
timeline.quote: was elevated to the rank of duke by Xarl in exchange for giving his son Eskil to the old mage as an apprentice.

citation.text: "Golthonor", section "Locations in Golthonor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Embereck destroys Eskil's hut, but Eskil takes him to New Argive, and Embereck learns of Ravidel's deceit and agrees to stand against him.
timeline.quote: Embereck agreed to stand against him.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat gathers the fragments of the Grey Chime; Kristina, Sandruu and Freyalise assault Telemar.
timeline.quote: Kristina, Sandruu, and Freyalise launched their assault on Telemar.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir reconciles with Sandruu, and Teferi and Eskil free Daria from the Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Teferi retrieved Daria's Amber Prison, and with Eskil’s help, freed her at last.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi retrieves the Amber Prison and Eskil releases Daria.
timeline.quote: Teferi retrieves the Amber Prison from the Null Moon and Eskil releases Daria from it.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Embereck destroys Eskil's hut, thinking Eskil summoned him.

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Dragon's Dance , by David Quinn , Kenny Martinez and Anibal Rodriguez". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eskil takes Embereck to New Argive, where Embereck tells of recovering the Golgothian Sylex and showing mercy to Ravidel.
timeline.quote: This convinced the more powerful planeswalker to hand over the Sylex to the Battle Mage.

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Dragon's Dance , by David Quinn , Kenny Martinez and Anibal Rodriguez". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eskil reveals Ravidel created the Mox Beacon, and Embereck agrees to fight him.

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Dragon's Dance , by David Quinn , Kenny Martinez and Anibal Rodriguez". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xarl dies; Trine escapes and is killed by her angelic sisters; Eskil inherits the House and becomes a Planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Eskil in turn became an immortal Planeswalker
